Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Evac+Chair Evac+Sheet is a rescue sheet for the fast evacuation of non-ambulatory patients in an emergency. It stays in place under the mattress, out of sight and without getting in the way of bed making, so it is ready the moment a patient needs to be moved.
When it is time to evacuate, staff wrap the sheet’s straps around the patient and the mattress and pull them out together. The mattress cushions the patient, especially going down the stairs, and the long pulling straps at the head and feet let one or more people move them. This patient evacuation sheet fits all bed models and mattresses.
Pulling Straps: Long pulling straps at the head and feet, so several rescuers can help
Material: Strong, easy-slide material for efficient patient movement
Rubber Side Panels: Stop the patient slipping when getting into or out of bed, and lift clear of the floor when the sheet is secured for an evacuation
Cross Straps: Reinforcing cross straps sewn all the way across the sheet, for strength when it is pulled over rough surfaces
Buckles: Plastic strap buckles, safer than metal and fully washable
Press Studs: Keep the cross straps and pulling straps tucked under the mattress, so they do not fall or catch in the bed frame or rails, and stay easy to reach
Installation Label: "This Side Up" label for correct installation, with space for a ward name or number
Set-Up: No installation, belay system, or ropes needed; ready to use instantly
Fit: Fits all bed models and mattresses
Weight Capacity: 660 lbs
Size: 75”L×36”W
Warranty: 2-year manufacturer’s warranty
Available Models and Options
220-SHEET – Evac+Sheet: Under-mattress rescue sheet, 75”×36”, 660 lb capacity
[H2] Applications
The Evac+Sheet suits any facility where patients or residents may be bedbound when an evacuation is needed.
Typical applications include:
Hospital wards and intensive care units
Nursing homes, senior living, and long-term care facilities
Behavioral health, hospice, and rehabilitation facilities
Explore Anchortex's Evacuation Chairs and Stretchers collection for more evacuation equipment.
[H2] Frequently Asked Questions
What is a rescue sheet?
A rescue sheet, or bed evacuation sheet, is a strong sheet that stays under the mattress of a patient’s bed. In an emergency, staff strap the patient to the mattress and pull both to safety, so the patient never has to be lifted out of bed.
Can the Evac+Sheet go down stairs?
Yes. The patient stays on their mattress, which protects them as the sheet is pulled down the stairs.
Does the evacuation sheet get in the way of bed making?
No. It sits under the mattress permanently, with its straps held in place by press studs, so beds are made as usual.
[H2] About Evac+Chair Evacuation Chairs
Evac+Chair makes stair evacuation chairs, powered stair chairs, evacuation sleds, and accessories for moving people with limited mobility on stairs, in an emergency or every day.
The Evac+Chair line includes:
Emergency evacuation chairs: The 300H, 400H, 600H, and 750H stair evacuation chairs for controlled travel down the stairs
Powered stair climbing chairs: The battery powered Power 800 and Power 900 for going up and down the stairs
Stair transport seat: The IBEX 700H Tran-Seat for two-person transport up and down the stairs
Evacuation sleds and mats: The Evac+Sled, Ulti-Mat, and Evac+Sheet rescue sheet
Accessories: Comfy Seat, transfer seat, storage cabinets, anti-theft alarms, and the iEvac smoke and fire escape hood
[H2] About Evac+Chair
Evac+Chair has made stairway evacuation chairs since 1982, and its chairs were designed in the United States. Explore the full line of Evac+Chair evacuation chairs at Anchortex.
